prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1254; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left tail lamp housing is broken, with scuffing and paint transfer on the lower panel. These marks line up with the low-speed contact described in the claim. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp assembly, refinishing the adjacent quarter panel, and recalibrating the parking sensors. Labor time is consistent with the extent of the damage. The invoices provided show no duplicate line items or repeated charges. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, so the repairs described are limited to this incident.
